result.topic_en: Measurements of the micrometer thread spacing (Fadenweite) of a transit instrument in 1818, derived from transits of the Pole Star and of other stars on April 20, with the declination factors used to reduce them.

methods.what: Thread interval determined from transit times of several stars, reduced by the factor sec(declination) (normalized to γ Virginis); the summed intervals are divided by the summed factors to give a mean thread distance
Thread interval from Pole Star transits on several dates
